mechanism.claim: When Binance BTCUSDT spot and perpetual move in the same direction during a completed hour but a large cash-market move is transmitted only partially to the perpetual while both BVOL and DVOL expand, cash-led price discovery should pull the perpetual in the same direction for six hours.
mechanism.side: sign of the completed spot return
mechanism.why_distinct: SLVCR uses hourly spot-versus-perpetual price transmission under joint crypto implied-volatility expansion. CSPR used five-minute signed-flow coherence, execution centroids, and opposite perpetual capital/event flow; SLVCR uses none of those. PVIAR used premium-index intrahour acceleration, and DQDIR used stablecoin quote-flow topology plus OI contraction.
mechanism.why_low_gross9_overlap_is_plausible: cash-led hourly spot/perpetual transmission under dual implied-volatility ignition is absent from Gross9

clock.decision: T after exact completed UTC hour [T-1h,T)
clock.returns: hour_close/hour_open-1 independently for spot and perpetual
clock.spot_tail: nonzero abs spot return >= strictly-prior 720h q60 with 672 valid observations
clock.direction_agreement: spot and perpetual completed-hour returns have the same nonzero sign
clock.volatility_ignition: normalized completed-hour BVOL and DVOL bodies are both strictly positive
clock.trigger: false-to-true onset with prior source-valid consecutive hour
clock.reservation: global half-open, exit first on equal open
clock.funding: not a signal input; exact settlements only for later PnL

economic_gates.accounting: fixed quantity, exact funding marks, 6bp base and 10bp stress per notional side, every held 5m favorable then adverse, global HWM, full-calendar CAGR

source_plan.execution_price: sealed until source-support and Gross9 novelty pass
